notes: Re-grant link beside the green 'Consent granted' pill on each bundle row. Clicking it re-opens Microsoft's consent flow so you can refresh appRoleAssignments when Graph calls are 403ing on missing scopes (the 'permission drift' case where the app's declared scopes changed since the customer admin's first Accept)

Consented bundle rows are no longer hidden from the consent panel — they stay visible alongside un-consented ones so the Re-grant escape hatch is always reachable. Reverses the brief stretch where the panel disappeared when every bundle was already consented
